モクゥ……モククゥ……
Entry.EnglishText: Baa...baa...

Entry.JapaneseText: お前……心配してくれてんの？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh... were you worried about me?

Entry.JapaneseText: も〜〜〜近づくなってば！ パチパチなんだよ、お前はっ
Entry.EnglishText: Nu-uh, back it up! You're too zappy!

Entry.JapaneseText: ぐふふ、久しぶりじゃな <Beryl>！ 大きく……
Entry.EnglishText: Heheh, it's been a while, Beryl! My, you've grown...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なっておらんな？
Entry.EnglishText: ...What, no response?

Entry.JapaneseText: し、師匠!?
Entry.EnglishText: M-master?!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん……そ〜だよ。 ど〜せ、ボクなんて 何も変わらないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph... whatever. Nothing you can say will change anything.

Entry.JapaneseText: お前のつれの美人くらい バイ〜ンと成長しとるかと思ったが がっかりじゃのぉ
Entry.EnglishText: I thought you'd grow into a really beauty like your friend back there, what a shame...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>に会ったの？ ……あの人はスゴイよ。 強くて美人で、自分に負けないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: You met Ines? Yeah... she's amazing. She's strong, beautiful and doesn't let anyone tell her otherwise.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに<Kohaku>…… 優しくて、勇気があって 可愛くてさ……あんなの反則だよ
Entry.EnglishText: And then there's Kohaku... she's kind, and brave, and cute too... how unfair is that?

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、こら！ お前は 宮廷画家になるんじゃろう!? 美人かどうかは関係ないぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: So what? Your dream is to become a court painter, right?! You don't need to be a looker to do that!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ボクも、少しだけ成長したよ。 世界にはボク程度の絵描きは 山ほどいるってわかったんだ
Entry.EnglishText: ...But I did some growing too. I found out the world is full of painters better than me.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに……自分を守ってくれた 友達に嫉妬するようなスピリアで きれいな絵が描けるはずないよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Besides... how can I paint something beautiful with a Spira that's full of jealousy for the friends who'd risk their lives to protect me...

Entry.JapaneseText: バッカモ〜ン、自信を持て！ お前はこの巨匠アラゴの 一番弟子なんじゃぞ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Don't be an idiot, have some faith in yourself! You are the most promising desciple of the great Master Arago!

Entry.JapaneseText: 自信なんか持てるもんかっ！ 師匠なんて、こんな山の中に 引きこもった三流画家じゃないか！
Entry.EnglishText: How am I supposed to do that?! My master's just some thrid-rate artist who's holed himself up in the mountains!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……そうだな。 だが、お前は超一流の宮廷画家 シンハラ＝ベニトの孫じゃないか
Entry.EnglishText: ...You may be right. But, you're also the grandaughter of the first-class court painter Sinhala Benito.

Entry.JapaneseText: 伝説の宮廷画家シンハラ＝ベニト……
Entry.EnglishText: The legendary court painter Sinhala Benito...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……確かに、自分の芸術のために グランマを見捨てるような スピリアの醜さは似てるかもね
Entry.EnglishText: ...I guess your right, I'm just like him and his dumb ugly Spiria that abandoned Gram-gram for the sake of his art.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、だからこそ ボクは、そんな奴とは 違う絵を描きたいんだっ！
Entry.EnglishText: But that's exactly why I wanna paint in a totally different way from him!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうじゃ。 描きたいなら描けばいい。 お前は、お前の絵を……な
Entry.EnglishText: That's right. If you want to draw, then draw. Your art is is a reflection of yourself, after all...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ごめん、師匠。 言いすぎたよ
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm sorry, Master. I went too far.

Entry.JapaneseText: いいさ。確かにワシは 世界一美しい山頂に、どんな絵を 描いたらいいかわからん三流じゃ
Entry.EnglishText: It's quite alright. To tell the truth, not even I know what kind of painting I should draw on the most beautiful mountain in the world.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃが、いつか必ず この風景と溶け合う 世界一の絵を描きあげてみせるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: But one day, I WILL paint the perfect piece that seamlessly blends with its surroundings!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界一の山頂に、世界一の絵…… それが師匠の夢なんだね
Entry.EnglishText: The world's best painting for the world's tallest mountain... that's always been your dream, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: さ、そろそろ帰らんと ヘリオ祖母さんが心配して 迎えにくる頃じゃ
Entry.EnglishText: Come one, you should head back. Any longer and your poor grandma might get worried and come looking.

Entry.JapaneseText: 近頃、ヘリオは目が悪くなっててな。 こんな所まで登らせちゃ危ないぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: Her eyesight has been getting worse lately. It's not safe for her to come climbing up the mountain, is it?

Entry.JapaneseText: えっ、グランマの目が？ 全然気付かなかった……
Entry.EnglishText: Huh, Gram-gram's sight? I didn't even notice...

Entry.JapaneseText: ははは、かわいい孫の顔を見て 治っちまったのかもしれんなぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, maybe seeing her cute little granddaughters face healed them right up?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……おっと、ワシもボケて 肝心な事を言い忘れておった……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Oh, I nearly forgot the most important thing...

Entry.JapaneseText: お帰り、<Beryl>
Entry.EnglishText: Welcome home, Beryl.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ただいま、師匠
Entry.EnglishText: ...Glad to be back, Master.

Entry.JapaneseText: 待て、<Shing>。 <Beryl>を連れて 帰るのではないのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, Shing. Didn't we come here to bring Beryl back?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん…… でも、あのふたりの邪魔をしちゃ いけない気がするんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah... but I feel like we shouldn't get in their way.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘリオさんに、アラゴ師匠…… <Beryl>には、こんな あたたかな故郷があったのね
Entry.EnglishText: Both Mrs. Helio and Master Arago... everyone from Beryl's hometown are so lovely.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……このまま、<Beryl>を オレたちの旅に巻きこんで いいのかな？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Is it really okay to get Beryl wrapped up in our dangerous journey?

Entry.JapaneseText: あいつには 戦わなきゃならねぇ 理由はねーんだよな……
Entry.EnglishText: There's no reason a kid like her should have to fight...

Entry.JapaneseText: あのクリードは、理由なく 戦うには厳しすぎる相手よね
Entry.EnglishText: Creed is too strong a foe to fight without any incentive.

Entry.JapaneseText: 同意だ。戦闘中に <Beryl>のスピリアが折れれば それは全員の死に直結する
Entry.EnglishText: I concur. If Beryl's Spiria was to break in the heat of battle, it would cetrainly spell everyone's death.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだよね……ボクみたいな 覚悟のないヘタレは みんなの足手まといだよね？
Entry.EnglishText: You're right... some lazy bum like me would only get in the way, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 聞いてたのか、<Beryl>
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you were listening...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……<Shing>たちこそね
Entry.EnglishText: ...And so were you.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたは あのシンハラ＝ベニトの 孫だったのね
Entry.EnglishText: So you're Sinhala Benito's granddaughter, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 有名な奴なのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Is he a big deal?

Entry.JapaneseText: 先代ジルコニア陛下に 最も寵愛された 筆頭宮廷画家……
Entry.EnglishText: He was the cheif court painter, and personal favorite of Emperor Zirconia...

Entry.JapaneseText: 代表作の『宝石姫の肖像』は 絵の中の女性にスピリアが 宿ると評される国宝よ
Entry.EnglishText: His magnum opus “Portrait of the Gem Princess” is a national treasure, and it's said the woman in the painting has a Spiria of her very own.

Entry.JapaneseText: けど、天涯孤独の身と 聞いていたから、<Beryl>が 身内とは気付かなかったわ
Entry.EnglishText: But I heard he had no family left, so I never thought that Beryl could be a relative of his.

Entry.JapaneseText: 天涯孤独なのは あいつが家族を捨てたからさ！
Entry.EnglishText: The reason he had no family was because he ABANDONED them!

Entry.JapaneseText: パパとママが 山の事故で死んだ時も 帰ってこなかった……
Entry.EnglishText: Even when Mama and Papa died in an accident in the mountains, he still didn't come home...

Entry.JapaneseText: あんな奴の絵は偽物だって ボクは、あいつ以上の画家に なって証明してやるんだっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Even that jerk's paintings are all a sham, and I'll prove it by becoming an even BETTER artist that him!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクがなりたいのは ソーマ使いでも救世主でもない！ 宮廷画家なんだよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I don't wanna be some savior or Somatic! What I wanna be is a court painter!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……そうだった。 今まで当たり前のように つき合わせちゃって、ごめん
Entry.EnglishText: ...I see. You said so from the very start. I'm really sorry for dragging you along this far.

Entry.JapaneseText: 改めて聞くよ。オレたちと 一緒に行くか、ここで別れるか ……<Beryl>が選んでくれ
Entry.EnglishText: But I'll ask once more. Would you like to come with us, or part ways here... the choice is yours.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……もし……だったら…………
もしボクが<Kohaku>だったら 『一緒に行こう』って言うくせにっ
Entry.EnglishText: But if I were Kohaku, you'd just say “let's go together”!

Entry.JapaneseText: わかったよ！ ここでお別れだよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I get it, okay?! This is where i say goodbye!!

Entry.JapaneseText: おい、待てよ、<Beryl>！ 本当にいいのか、<Shing>!?
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, hold up Beryl! Are you really okay with this, Shing?!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Beryl>が決めたなら …………いいんだ
Entry.EnglishText: This was her choice so... yeah.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……マ、マジかよ!?
Entry.EnglishText: ...Seriously?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 仕方なかったんじゃ…… <Beryl>が生まれてすぐ あいつの両親は事故で亡くなった
Entry.EnglishText: It's to be expected... not long after she was born, she lost both her parents in an awful accident.

Entry.JapaneseText: あの時、シンハラはジルコニア 陛下に幽閉され『宝石姫の肖像』を 描くように強制されていたんじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: During that time, Sinhala was imprisoned by Emperor Zirconia, and was forced to paint the Portrait of the Gem Princess.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃが、<Beryl>とヘリオに 寂しい思いをさせたのは事実…… 言い訳はできんがな
Entry.EnglishText: Regardless of the excuse, Beryl and Helio couldn't help but feel hurt.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……しかし、成長してないなんて 大間違いじゃった
Entry.EnglishText: ...But she's silly to think she didn't grow up at all.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Beryl>も、もう一人前の 娘なんじゃの……
Entry.EnglishText: Beryl's not the same girl she was before...

Entry.JapaneseText: だめだ…… 中から鍵をかけてる
Entry.EnglishText: Darn it. It's locked from the inside.

Entry.JapaneseText: すぐそこが、お山の頂上だ
Entry.EnglishText: That's the mountain summit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 足を踏みはずすと １０００メートルは落ちるから 気をつけろよ
Entry.EnglishText: If you slip it's a 1,000 meter drop, so be careful!

Entry.JapaneseText: （声が出せないようだ）

Entry.JapaneseText: おムコ候補さんたちよ <Beryl>をよろしく頼むぜ。 泣かせたりしたら承知しないぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hello Beryl's marriage candidates. You better not make her cry!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……って、そりゃ無理か!? <Beryl>は どうでもいい事でも泣くもんなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: I guess that's not possible though. She cries over everything!

Entry.JapaneseText: すーはー、すーはー……
Entry.EnglishText: *inhale*

Entry.JapaneseText: この村で生まれ育ったから 空気が薄いっていわれても わからないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: I was born and raised here, so it's hard for me to feel like the air is particularly thin up here.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あんたが幸薄そうな顔なのは わかるんだけどねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: I sure can tell it's getting to you though.

Entry.JapaneseText: （声が出せないようだ）

Entry.JapaneseText: すーはー、すーはー……
Entry.EnglishText: *inhale*

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、デスピル病から復活して 吸う空気は、おいしいねぇ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, I love breathing in the fresh air, now that the despir is gone.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたたちのおかげだ。 ありがとうよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is all thanks you kiddos. Thank you.
